paragraphs: Mentioned in [Pesachim 118a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.118a.21) according to Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim; our reading is R' Shimon HaShiloni.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim introduces the exposition as Rabbi Shimon HaSheloni (השלוני). Hyman reports the form “of Sidon” from Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim.
[Heilprin’s separate Sidon headword](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3477&lang=en) says he did not find an occurrence.
Hyman preserves the two forms as variant names. His Sidon heading does not by itself establish where this Rabbi Shimon lived.
